name: Yes Bank Limited
remarksWeb: The Bank had received disclosure from CA Basque Investments (Investor) under Regulation 29(2) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeover) Regulations, 2011 dated June 03, 2025, that the Investor had sold 2.62% shareholding in the Bank. Pursuant to the foregoing, the current shareholding of the Investor in the Bank is 4.22%. Accordingly, in accordance with the terms of the investment agreement dated July 29, 2022 executed between the Investor and the Bank, the Investor no longer has the right to nominate a director on the board of the Bank
revisionRemark: Resubmission is done to mention the holding of LIC separately under the category Insurance Companies as required to be disclosed name of the shareholder holding 1 percent or more of total no of shares

name: Yes Bank Limited
revisionRemark: Filing revised Shareholding Pattern for the quarter ended March 31, 2024 incorporating warrant details which were missed out inadvertently. Apart from the aforesaid, there is no change in the Shareholding Pattern filed on April 17, 2024.

name: Yes Bank Limited
revisionRemark: We had filed the Shareholding Pattern for the quarter ended March 31, 2023 on April 12, 2023. In this regard we have received an email from BSE regarding discrepancy in reporting shareholding under category of Bodies Corporate which is reported twice, firstly in Bodies Corporate and in Any Others category in Non-Institutions.    Therefore, we propose to file revised Shareholding Pattern for the quarter ended March 31, 2023 incorporating the above changes.    Apart from the aforesaid, there is no change in the Shareholding Pattern filed on April 12, 2023.

name: Yes Bank Limited
revisionRemark: We had filed the Shareholding Pattern for the quarter ended December 31, 2021 on January 13, 2022. However, inadvertently for the shareholders holding more than 1% i.e.  Housing Development Finance Corporation Limited  and  Kotak Mahindra Bank Limited  in Non-institutions/Any others category; the category selected was mentioned as  Others  in place of  Bodies Corporate . Therefore a revised Shareholding Pattern for the quarter ended December 31, 2021 is being filed.    Apart from the aforesaid, there is no change in the Shareholding Pattern from the one which was filed on January 13, 2022. We request you to kindly take the said shareholding pattern on record and disseminate the same.
